designDecisions: ONE SEAM: the migration bridge (condition-absent archetype chain in writeBodyRelief), the four label-keyed dispatch predicates (isEarthlikePlatePath/isShellReliefPath/isVolcanicPath/isStagnantLidPath) + the VOLCANIC_ARCHETYPES set, and the V2-5s bridge-tune gate (the `bodyDrivers?.condition ? shellDriversToTune(...) : null` conditional in the bridge's shell branch) are deleted TOGETHER in planet-lod-rivers.js. They are one mechanism; a partial deletion would leave dead exports or an unreachable gate.

CONDITION-LESS INPUT THROWS. Post-retirement, writeBodyRelief without bodyDrivers.condition fails loudly with a clear error, and that behavior is itself tested. Rationale: a silent despun default could mask an unmigrated caller as a distant byte-diff; a throw surfaces it at the call site. The build plan may amend this shape only with enumerated rationale.

PRESET_ARCHETYPE SURVIVES FOR RADIUS SELECTION (V2-3 R-GARBLE adjudication). The map and the lab's radius plumbing are untouched. Retirement = the dispatch bridge only, never the radius map. The dispatch-oracle garble test's radius exemption stays intact.

TEST RE-ANCHORING IS ENUMERATED, NEVER SILENT (the V2-3 M3/MF-4 discipline). Two classes: (a) the ~8 condition-less writeBodyRelief call sites — worldengine-base-plate-driver-response (the 'ice'/'impact-airless' pairs incl. the AC5 D_OFF no-clobber variants), worldengine-plate-regime-gate (3 calls), planet-lod-rivers-discharge-param, and the condition-less `relief(...)` helpers in worldengine-base-magmatism-structure / worldengine-base-magmatism-multiply / worldengine-base-stagnantlid-structure / worldengine-shell-regime-gate, plus worldengine-base-shell-multiply's bridge-byte-safety AC (whose subject dies with the bridge — repurposed or retired, enumerated) — each migrates to a condition-bearing bundle that routes to the SAME writer with the SAME args (the existing bundle17/dispatchBundle/buildBundle idioms are the pattern). (b) the four suites that IMPORT the deleted predicates to compose the legacy chain as an oracle — worldengine-v2-3-dispatch-oracle (writer_today), worldengine-e1-conformance-oracle, worldengine-lid-classifier, worldengine-v2-3-taxonomy — re-anchor to pinned expected-route tables (or a frozen test-local reference copy; build plan's pick, enumerated per suite). The AC-0 label-free grep test re-anchors its slice marker ONLY if the block shape forces it, enumerated.

MF#3 COUNTING RULE (carried from the V2-3 build plan): the full-suite gate pins BOTH failure counts (Tests failed == 4 AND Test Files failed == 17) and asserts every touched/added test file still collects and runs a NONZERO test count — a silently-uncollected suite must not read green.

SCOPE-CLEAN COMMITS: git diff touches ONLY planet-lod-rivers.js, src/worldengine/base/lidResponse.js, the enumerated test files, and this workstream's docs. The not-ours dirty files (src/auto/CameraChoreographer.js, src/debug/LabMode.js) and the untracked screenshot/qa-results pile stay out of every commit. The v2-0 golden fixtures are NEVER re-captured (fixture files absent from the diff).
